create_MLIPPredictUnit: create an MLIPPredictUnit from a model checkpoint path to run MLIP inference on atomic data
run_MLIPPredictUnit_predict: run predictions on AtomicData using an MLIPPredictUnit to get energy, forces, and stress outputs
create_ParallelMLIPPredictUnit: create a ParallelMLIPPredictUnit with multiple Ray workers for distributed MLIP inference across GPUs
run_collate_predictions: run the collate_predictions decorator to aggregate per-system and per-atom predictions from batched AtomicData
create_BatchServerPredictUnit: create a BatchServerPredictUnit wrapping a Ray Serve handle for batched MLIP inference with input validation
